manifesto.title: THE TRENCHES
paragraphs: Loop Gaiden turns modern market culture into an evolving comic and animated series.
Crypto. Stocks. Wall Street. Reddit. Memes. Crashes. Squeezes. Whatever the market cannot stop talking about.
statements:
THE MARKET WRITES THE HEADLINES.
THE TRENCHES TURN THEM INTO STORIES. ♾️

origin.title: LOOP CAME BACK TO FIND OUT HOW THE TRENCHES WERE BORN.
paragraphs: In Loop’s future, markets, machines and communities have merged into something new. Nobody remembers how it started.
Loop travels back through the moments, memes, crashes and strange characters that shaped market culture.
He isn’t here to change history. He came back to understand it. Every episode reveals another piece.
origin.final:
THE PAST CREATED THE TRENCHES.
LOOP CAME BACK TO SEE HOW. ∞

mission.title: AN EVOLVING SERIES
mission.body: The markets never stay still. Neither does Loop Gaiden.

chapters.title: THE STORY MOVES WITH THE MARKET
chapters.body: Each season gathers stories from a moment in market culture. A season can move through memecoin mania, Wall Street chaos, Reddit-fueled trades, stock-market euphoria, crashes, squeezes, IPOs, hype cycles and whatever narrative takes over next. Stories are never locked to one saga. If the market is talking about it, it can enter the series.
chapters.callout: THE MARKET NEVER STOPS. NEITHER DO THE STORIES. ∞

chapters.title: MARKET MOMENT → SHORT STORY
chapters.body: Loop Gaiden transforms the culture, characters and narratives moving through the markets into short fictional comic and animated episodes. The goal is not to report the market. The goal is to turn its madness into stories.
items: 01 — THE MARKET MOVES: A new narrative captures everyone's attention.
02 — THE TRENCHES REACT: Traders, communities and the internet turn it into culture.
03 — LOOP ENTERS THE STORY: That moment becomes a run of short episodes.
chapters.callout: CRYPTO. STOCKS. WALL STREET. MEMES. MARKET PSYCHOLOGY. INTERNET CULTURE.

chapters.title: ONE CHARACTER. INFINITE STORIES.
chapters.body: Loop moves through the shadows of the market. Different seasons. Different narratives. Different characters. Different battles. But the trenches are always there. The world around Loop can change with every story while his identity remains constant. He is the thread connecting the entire series.
chapters.callout: THE MARKET CHANGES. LOOP KEEPS MOVING. ∞

final.title:
The next story
is already happening.
final.body: Somewhere in crypto, stocks or Wall Street, the next narrative is already starting. When the trenches start talking, Loop is watching.
final.status: THE MARKET WRITES THE HEADLINES. WE TURN THEM INTO COMICS. ∞

community.title: THE COMMUNITY IS PART OF THE STORY
community.body:
Loop Gaiden is built around the culture of the trenches.

The memes. The theories. The wins. The losses. The ridiculous moments. The stories traders remember.

The community can help surface the narratives, characters and moments worth turning into future seasons and short episodes.

THE TRENCHES DON'T JUST WATCH THE STORY.
THEY LIVE IN IT.
